pins._pwm_slice_note: RP2350 PWM: slice=(gp>>1)&7, channel A=even/B=odd. Lasers GP8-15 = slices 4A,4B,5A,5B,6A,6B,7A,7B (1 kHz). Threshold GP21 = 2B (20 kHz). Same slice+channel = one output; frequency is per slice. Checked at startup by check_pwm_slices.

threshold_mux._pwm_note: Threshold PWM about 20 kHz, scope-tested by the user (raised from 1 kHz; REPL test script lost). This is the ONE threshold PWM frequency setting: pins_from_settings.py:226 and head_probe.py:8 still hard-code 1 kHz and should read it. GP21 replaced GP28: GP28 is slice 6A, the same output as bell 5's laser GP12. GP28 is now only the analog monitor (sense_gp). Do not move pwm_gp back to 28.

refresh._note: Two processes: a fast refresh loop re-writes each channel's current target (dwell_s per channel); a slow, infrequent update changes the targets as background light drifts. interval_s = max gap between refreshes of one channel, from the user's scope droop tests (authoritative; fill in). null -> datasheet estimate 100 nF x tol_v / bias_a = 20 ms, cross-check only.

pins._population_note: No 'fitted' list: socket population is detected at boot by the socket classifier / loopback self-test. connector_boards only says which boards exist (1-4 fitted, 5-8 absent).
